newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan domestic WPI falls 0.7 pct in 96/97 - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan domestic WPI falls 0.7 pct in 96/97 - BOJ.

text.p: Japan's domestic wholesale price index, a key component of the overall wholesale price index, fell 0.7 pct in fiscal 1996/97 from the previous year, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Tuesday.
It was the fifth year in a row in which domestic wholesale prices had fallen, the central bank said.
The overall wholesale price index rose 1.0 percent from a year earlier.
In yen terms, export prices rose 6.4 percent and import prices rose 12.8 percent, reflecting a weakening of the yen, it said.
